content.title: HTML & CSS Compatibility
content.lede: gowkhtmltopdf converts controlled, server-generated HTML and print templates to PDF and PNG: invoices, receipts, certificates, storybooks, posters, and multi-page tables with headers and footers. It is a PDF engine based on HTML templates without any wrappers, not a browser. The catalog tracks 818 W3C webref property names at 407 Implemented, 0 Partial, and 411 Unsupported (`plans/0.2.6/catalog/mapping.json`, after the v0.2.7 next-72 wave). `documentation/compatibility-matrix.md` is the normative per-property contract.

content.heading: What supported input means
items: A feature is supported only when the matrix says so: "Implemented" means parsed and consumed by layout and paint, backed by a code path in `internal/layout` or `internal/css` and usually a test or golden fixture under `testdata/golden/fixture-*.html`.

Anything not listed in the matrix is unsupported, and unsupported input must degrade gracefully: the declaration is ignored, the node is skipped, or a documented error is returned. It never crashes (`documentation/fidelity.md`, Failure modes).
The status legend is three-valued: Implemented, Partial (parsed and used for a subset; the rest degrades silently), and Not implemented (parsed and dropped, or never parsed).

Coverage counts are catalog-based, not prose: the W3C webref list holds 818 property names. After the v0.2.7 next-72 wave the mapping is 407 Implemented, 0 Partial, and 411 Unsupported (`plans/0.2.6/catalog/mapping.json`). 53 of the 72 next-72 names flipped Implemented; 19 stay Unsupported by choice.

Coverage added in 0.2.6: logical margins/padding/inset/sizing and logical border radii; multi-layer backgrounds (`background-size`, `-position`, `-repeat`, `-clip`, `-origin`); `border-image`; multi-layer `box-shadow` with inset and spread; `text-shadow` and decoration longhands (`text-decoration-thickness`, `-color`, `text-underline-offset`); static 2D `transform` plus individual `translate`/`rotate`/`scale`; and 28 `-webkit-*` aliases remapped to implemented bases (matrix 5.3).

The Next-72 table on this page names all 72 properties from that unreleased wave. 53 are Implemented. 19 stay Unsupported: `text-fit`, `shape-inside`, `shape-padding`, `shape-image-threshold`, `float-defer`, `border-clip`, `border-top-clip`, `border-right-clip`, `border-bottom-clip`, `border-left-clip`, `border-block-clip`, `border-block-start-clip`, `border-block-end-clip`, `border-inline-clip`, `border-inline-start-clip`, `border-inline-end-clip`, `border-limit`, `border-shape`, and `border-boundary`. The per-property contract remains `documentation/compatibility-matrix.md` section 2.3 and section 5.5.
Prefer the matrix over marketing prose: if a row says Implemented, there should be a code path and preferably a test or golden fixture to prove it.
CLI URL fetch over `http`/`https` is a supported input path, but it is not the same as browser-grade print: live URL output stays exploratory until Phase 21 acceptance against vendored fixtures.

content.heading: CSS property status
rows: Four-side shorthands; `solid`/`dashed`/`dotted`/`none` border styles; `thin`/`medium`/`thick` widths; sibling margin collapsing
Shorthand and longhands, `rx / ry` slash, elliptical Bezier paint, and percent corners resolved per axis
`%` resolves against a viewport approximation; consumed by blocks and images
Map to physical geometry for horizontal and vertical writing modes; tests `TestLogicalMargin`, `TestLogicalPadding`, `TestLogicalInset`, `TestLogicalSize`
Map onto physical corner radii across writing modes; catalog snapshot 2026-09-12

Sticky scrollport selection plus descendant paint clipping to the padding box for `hidden`/`clip`/`auto`/`scroll` (`overflow_clip.go`); logical `overflow-block`/`overflow-inline` map onto those axes; `visible` does not clip
Definite width produces height (and inverse) on blocks/flex/grid/replaced; replaced images cover/contain/none and position inside the content box (`aspect_ratio.go`, `object_fit.go`)
Multi-layer shadows with inset layers, spread expansion, and blur approximation; does not change layout size (`box_shadow.go`)
Border image slicing and tiling (`appendBorderImage`, `layout_chrome.go`); catalog snapshot 2026-09-12

Named and generic families; embedded Liberation Sans plus `--font-path`, `--use-system-fonts`, and `@font-face` TTF/OTF/WOFF1 from local paths or `https://`; missing faces fall back through the author stack to Liberation
px/pt/em/%/rem/in/cm/mm/pc and keywords; `%`/`em` resolve against the parent
Weight 700+ selects Liberation Bold; fake stroke bold only if the bold face is missing
Consumed in line metrics and run width
`text-indent` shifts the first line; `word-spacing` widens ASCII spaces; `text-transform` applies uppercase/lowercase/capitalize at measure and paint
One soft shadow copy per collected shadow, behind the run (`emitTextShadowRuns`, `inline_paint.go`)
Decoration longhands consumed in inline paint; `text-decoration-skip-*` subset per matrix 2.3
`normal`/`nowrap`/`pre`; `pre-wrap` preserves spaces and wraps; `pre-line` collapses spaces, keeps newlines, and wraps
Table cells top/middle/bottom; inline replaced elements against the baseline
Foreground cascade; background paint gated by `--background`
Color token plus multi-layer `background-image` (`url(...)`, pure-Go linear/radial gradients)
Multi-layer sizing (`contain`/`cover`/explicit), positioning, repeat tiling, and clip/origin boxes (`background_image.go`, `background_repeat.go`); catalog snapshot 2026-09-12
Collapsed border resolution with spacing suppressed; `table-layout: fixed` lite when the table width is definite; `caption-side` top/bottom/left/right
Canvas-Y flow shifts; table rows never split; `page-break-inside: avoid` honored
Media filtering against `Media: "print"`; size feature queries partial

Core values implemented; `flex`/`inline-flex` route to Stage A flex and `grid`/`inline-grid` to Stage B + C grid lite; `table-caption` renders above the table; `table-column`/`table-column-group` are not implemented
Out-of-flow packing with simple exclusion; in-flow tables always clear below floats
Static in-flow plus `relative`/`absolute`/`fixed` lite; `sticky` clamps `top`/`bottom`/`left`/`right` in the page content box (print scrollport) or an overflow box at offset 0
Left/right/center; `justify` distributes leftover space on non-final lines
OpenType language tag threaded into shaping (`shape_gotext.go`); observable with DejaVu Sans `SRB` `locl` substitution

28 alias names remap to implemented bases; 42 stay Unsupported, including `-webkit-background-clip`/`-origin`/`-size` whose unprefixed bases now ship (matrix 5.3)
Parsed (initial 2); fragmentation Rule 3 when line boxes are countable, geometric heuristic otherwise

Unnamed `margin`/`size` apply to every page; `:first`/`:left`/`:right` override margins (LTR page 1 is `:right`; `:first` wins); `page: ident` gives named pages with sibling breaks; `@top-*`/`@bottom-*` margin boxes fill empty CLI header/footer slots; size stays unnamed-only

These 19 next-72 names stay Unsupported. `text-fit` is stored and has no scale-search consumer. The other 18 have no apply arm and no paint (matrix section 2.3 and section 5.5).

content.heading: Explicitly unsupported
items: JavaScript: `<script>` is stripped at load and DOM APIs do not exist. `--enable-javascript`, `--run-script`, `--window-status`, and the other JS flags are not registered; they fail parse as `unknown option` (matrix 7.5, Policy A).

Browser parity: full WebKit or Chrome print parity is an explicit non-milestone; banned claims include pixel-perfect output, full CSS, and browser replacement (`documentation/fidelity.md`, Claims language).

WebP and AVIF are not implemented: the image is skipped or a broken-image placeholder is painted. SVG-as-`` is implemented through `internal/svg` (allowlisted `tdewolff/canvas`, rect/circle/path subset); the remaining 53 SVG presentation properties stay unsupported (matrix 5.2).

PDF encryption, duplex, and AcroForm: out of scope; `--produce-forms` is not registered and is rejected as an unknown option, and the PDF writer has no form model. PDF/A-3a, PDF/A-4, PDF/UA-1, and PDF/UA-2 shipped in 0.2.2 as opt-in `--pdf-profile` / `Document.PDFProfile` (default remains unclaimed PDF 1.4; version alone is not a claim). Older PDF/A-1 / A-2 and PDF/X stay absent.

`@font-face`: TTF/OTF (TrueType outlines) and WOFF1 load from local paths or `https://` through the `FetchSub` ACL and `NetworkPolicy` on PDF and image paths. WOFF2, EOT, and `data:` sources are skipped; CFF/`OTTO` fonts are rejected.
Complex-script shaping is partial: Arabic OT via `go-text/typesetting` (GSUB) with presentation-form fallback, CJK via Type0/CID; no CGO HarfBuzz.

content.title: Flex and grid are a print CSS subset
content.body: Stage A flex and Stage B/C grid lite cover grow/shrink/basis, order, wrap, `minmax()`, areas, dense packing, and `gap`. They are not Bootstrap or Tailwind parity and not Chrome layout-test parity. This page is a summary; the normative contract is `documentation/compatibility-matrix.md`, and any change to it goes through plan review as a plan amendment.
